title: E2E scenario
description: One user journey. Steps run in order and share values through ${ctx.name}.

version.description: Schema version this file is written for. Omit it to mean version 1

setup.description: Fixture names from the config, run before the first step

target.description: Target name from the config, or "shell"

extract.description: ctx name -> path in the step result, e.g. { "userId": "data[0].id" }

url.description: http: path relative to the service URL, or a full URL

action.description: web or mobile: declarative action name (navigate, click, fill, press, tap, type, etc.)

selector.description: web or mobile: CSS selector, accessibility label, ID, or text

value.description: web or mobile: text input value, target URL, or script code

key.description: web or mobile: keyboard key (e.g. Enter, BACK) or swipe direction

ms.description: web or mobile: duration in milliseconds for wait or delay

run.description: web: step module name in the target's modules folder

flow.description: mobile: YAML flow file in the target's flows folder

launch.description: mobile: launch the app through adb before the flow; fresh wipes app data

params.description: web: passed to the module; mobile: replaces ${NAME} in the flow

actions.description: web or mobile: ordered list of execution actions

cwd.description: shell: working directory, relative to the config file

action.description: Action name (e.g. navigate, click, fill, press, wait_for, tap, type, swipe, launch)

output_contains.description: shell: text in stdout or stderr

json_match.description: path -> expected value, or an operator: {"$exists": true}, {"$contains": "x"}, {"$notContains": "x"}, {"$gt": 0}, {"$gte": 0}
